crossGameFamilyReviews.name: drift-car
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Drift King archived; Drift Rush versus Neon Circuit still needs actual steering, timing, hazards and end-rule differentiation.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: delivery-driving
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Check deliveries/time bonuses versus lane-riding/traffic; common vehicle presentation is not sufficient distinction.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: basketball-throw
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Flick projectile baskets; confirm shifting-shot timer versus hoop-to-hoop platform chain is genuinely different.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: projectile-throw
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Swipe projectile physics overlaps; test rack/ball economy versus wind/three-misses target.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: reaction-targets
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Both tap targets; moving bugs, plant health and beneficial insects may be distinct from fixed timed grid.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: lane-survival-runner
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Compare actual movement/camera/hazard-failure families rather than title or graphics.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: survival-arena
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Verify distinct enemy AI, combat loops, skill effects, survival objectives and mobile control.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: tower-defense
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Validate tower pathing, building, upgrade balance and endless highscore, not just different art.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: tile-puzzle
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: 2048 merging, match-three swapping and Mahjong pairs appear rule-distinct but still need device/asset QA.

crossGameFamilyReviews.name: cannabis-precision
crossGameFamilyReviews.reason: Trim drawing, timing stages, belt sorting, multi-lane service; verify actual touch satisfaction and game title fidelity.

caution: Engine signature or different source SHA is not proof of unique gameplay. All devices, art and scoring evidence remain NOT_RUN until actually tested.

games.title: Block Drop
games.playableInstructionPreview: Arrows / swipe to move, Up / tap to rotate Down soft drop, Space hard drop, C hold

games.title: Maze Muncher
games.playableInstructionPreview: Arrows / swipe to steer Eat every dot, power pellets turn the hunters

games.title: Alien Rows
games.playableInstructionPreview: Move: arrows / drag   Fire: auto on touch, Space Shields crumble - clear every wave

games.title: Cloud Hopper
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tilt with arrows / hold left or right side Bounce up - springs, movers and breakers

games.title: Road Hopper
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / Up to hop forward, swipe or arrows to dodge Don\'t stall - the hawk is watching

games.title: Rock Buster
games.playableInstructionPreview: Desktop: arrows rotate/thrust, Space fire Touch: stick to steer + thrust, FIRE button

games.title: Star Swarm
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag / arrows to move, auto-fire while touching Space to fire - divers are worth double

games.title: Rail Rush
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe or arrows: change track Up: jump, down: roll - ride the ramps onto the trains
games.ownerIssue: Trains must have solid collision geometry; roof/ramp excepted

games.title: Hill Hauler
games.playableInstructionPreview: Hold right side / Right arrow = gas, left side / Left = brake Grab fuel cans, land flips for bonus, don\'t land on your head
games.ownerIssue: Consolidate all lookalike hill game variants into one strong representative

games.title: Most Wanted Run
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: left/right arrows or hold left/right side Survive the chase - make cops crash into each other
games.ownerIssue: Scenery impacts must not immediately end; police must immobilize for bust; integrate licensed diverse car models

games.title: Pop Defense
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap a tower card, then a grass tile to build Every balloon layer popped = 1 point. Tap towers to upgrade

games.title: Cube Horde
games.playableInstructionPreview: Move: WASD / drag anywhere - you auto-fire Blocky zombies come in waves - pick up power crates

games.title: Arrow Hero
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag anywhere to move (WASD / arrows). Stand still to auto-shoot Clear the room, walk through the gate, pick a skill on level-up
games.ownerIssue: Touch selection of level-up options interferes with virtual stick

games.title: Grid Wars
games.playableInstructionPreview: Move: WASD / drag   Aim: mouse (auto-aim on touch) B = smart bomb. Chain kills to raise the multiplier

games.title: Moon Swarm
games.playableInstructionPreview: Move: WASD / drag - weapons fire on their own Grab crystals to level up and pick upgrades. Survive the night.

games.title: Throttle Rider
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: arrows / hold left or right side Helmet-cam highway run - near misses and overtakes multiply

games.title: Wreck Ride
games.playableInstructionPreview: Right side / Right = pedal, Left side / Left = brake & lean back Up / Down lean in the air. Keep your head off the ground!

games.title: Rig Rally
games.playableInstructionPreview: BUILD: tap a slot to cycle parts, then GO RIDE: hold right = motors, hold left = fan. Collect stars, go far!

games.title: Goo Tower
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag a goo ball near the tower and let go - it links to the 2 nearest balls Build as high as you can. Wind gets stronger. Don\'t let it topple!

games.title: Keep Guard
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap a tower card, then a grass tile to build Tap towers to upgrade. Barracks train guards that stop ground raiders in melee until defeated, then respawn. Protect the keep against endless raids

games.title: Node Siege
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap a tower card, then a tile to build - towers block, so build a maze Tap towers to upgrade. Endless waves, bosses every 10

games.title: Orb Coil
games.playableInstructionPreview: Aim with mouse / drag, release or click to shoot Space / tap the idol swaps orbs. Match 3+ before the coil reaches the pit

games.title: Neon Flipper
games.playableInstructionPreview: Left / right side of the screen (or Z and M / arrow keys) flip Hold, then release to launch. Light the lanes for a multiplier

games.title: Light Cycle
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe or arrow keys to steer (tap left / right side to turn) Don\'t hit any trail. Last rider standing wins the round

games.title: Roof Runner
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / Space to jump (hold = higher) Don\'t fall between the rooftops

games.title: Helix Drop
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag sideways / arrows to spin the tower Drop through gaps - red zones break you

games.title: Hex Spin
games.playableInstructionPreview: Hold left / right side (or arrows) to orbit Survive the closing walls - score = time

games.title: Color Hop
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / Space to hop upward Pass through segments of YOUR colour only

games.title: Zig Path
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / Space to switch direction Stay on the path, grab the gems

games.title: Drift King
games.playableInstructionPreview: Hold to turn right, release to turn left Keep the car on the winding road

games.title: Missile Guard
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / click the sky to launch an interceptor Blast radius takes out incoming warheads

games.title: Bug Blaster
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag / arrows to move in the bottom zone Auto-fire on touch, Space to fire

games.title: Bubble Pop
games.playableInstructionPreview: Aim by dragging / mouse, release to shoot Arrows aim + Space shoots. Match 3 or more

games.title: Mine Sweep
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap to reveal, long-press (or right-click / F) to flag Clear boards back to back - 3 lives

games.title: Knife Toss
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / Space to throw Don\'t hit other knives - apples are bonus

games.title: Mole Whack
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap the critters as they pop up (or keys 1-9) Avoid bombs. Begin with 30 seconds; correct hits add time - combos multiply

games.title: Grow Op
games.referenceLoop: Cannabis grow sim (Weed Firm / Hempire style)
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap a plant to select it, then WATER / FEED / SWAT Harvest when the trichome meter is gold. Endless grow cycles; 3 dead plants ends the run.

games.title: Trim Rush
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe across the green leaves. Avoid the central bud! Start with 30s; accurate cuts earn time.

games.title: Strain Crush
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe a gem into a neighbour to swap (or tap two) Match 3+ strains; cascades multiply. Start with 60s; matches add time.

games.title: Bud Bar
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap any counter once to serve that lane (or Up/Down + Space). Catch returning empties by selecting their lane.

games.title: Green Dash
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: drag / arrows. Hit the glowing drop zones Each delivery adds time - dodge traffic

games.title: Roll Up
games.referenceLoop: Cannabis rolling precision game (Perfect Slices / timing style)
games.playableInstructionPreview: 21+ only. Tap to stop the needle in the zone (GRIND, ROLL, SEAL) FILL: hold to pour, release on the line. Perfects build a streak multiplier

games.title: Smoke Rings
games.referenceLoop: Cannabis lounge ring-blowing skill game (aim + power shot)
games.playableInstructionPreview: 21+ only. Drag to aim, hold to build breath, release to puff a ring Thread rings through the brass hoops - centre hits score double

games.title: Bud Sort
games.playableInstructionPreview: 21+ only. Swipe each jar toward the bin of its colour (or tap the bin / arrows + Q/E) Stems & seeds: swipe DOWN to reject. Don\'t let the gate jam

games.title: Pest Patrol
games.playableInstructionPreview: 21+ only. Tap bugs to squash them before they reach your plants Blue beetles take two taps. Never squash the ladybugs - they help

games.title: Cup Toss
games.playableInstructionPreview: 21+ only. Press and hold: the power meter rises and falls; swipe up and release to throw Aim with swipe direction - mind the wobble Sink every cup to re-rack. Racks slide back and start to sway

games.title: Beat Tiles
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap the dark tiles in order, bottom to top (or D F J K) Hold long tiles to the end. Never tap white space

games.title: Moon Lander
games.playableInstructionPreview: Left / right rotate, up thrust (or the on-screen buttons) Touch down on a pad slowly (< 40) and upright. Small pads pay more

games.title: Pin Strike
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe up to bowl: start position = where you stand, direction = aim, curve the swipe for hook, faster = harder. Frames under 7 pins cost a life

games.title: Bullseye
games.playableInstructionPreview: Press and drag to aim, release to shoot. The sight steadies, then tires after 3 s Aim into the wind and above for drop. Hit 15+ per end of 3 arrows

games.title: Spot Kick
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe the ball toward the goal: direction aims, speed lifts it, a bent swipe curls it Beat the keeper; corner rings pay double. 3 misses or saves end it

games.title: Glow Echo
games.playableInstructionPreview: Watch the pads light up, then tap them back in the same order (keys 1-5) Each round adds a step and speeds up. Pads move from round 14

games.title: Knockout Ring
games.playableInstructionPreview: Dodge: swipe / A D / arrows.  Block: hold the bottom / S / down.  Punch: tap upper-left/right (J K) Counter while he is open after a miss. STAR full: U or double tap for an uppercut

games.title: Putt Party
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag back from anywhere, release to putt (slingshot). Longer drag = harder Slopes push, sand slows, water costs a stroke. Beat par for bonus

games.title: Cue Club
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag back from anywhere and release to shoot (slingshot). Longer = harder Pot every ball to re-rack. A turn without a pot or a scratch costs a chalk

games.title: Long Ball
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap to swing as the pitch reaches the plate Tap on the side the ball crosses for solid contact (Space swings centre) Homers score by distance; streaks multiply. 10 outs ends the run

games.title: Rally Court
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag or use arrows to move along the baseline The racket swings by itself: where the ball meets it aims the shot Keep rallies going; beat the rival for big points. 3 lives

games.title: Ice Snipe
games.playableInstructionPreview: You skate in automatically. Drag left/right to stickhandle (arrows too) Swipe up to shoot: direction aims, speed lifts. Space shoots straight Deke the goalie, then shoot the other way. 3 misses end it

games.title: Reel Deal
games.playableInstructionPreview: Hold to charge the cast, release to throw (deeper = bigger fish) When the bobber dips, TAP fast to hook Hold to reel; keep tension in the green. 3 lost fish end the run

games.title: Hoop Streak
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe up from the ball to shoot: aim and speed set the arc Makes add time, swishes add more; 3 in a row = FIRE (x2) Endless until the clock hits zero

games.title: Kickflip City
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap to ollie (hold = higher). In the air swipe: \u2190 kickflip  \u2192 heelflip  \u2193 shove-it  \u2191 grab Finish the trick before landing. Land on rails to grind; tap to pop off Cones and barriers = bail. 3 bails end the run

games.title: Tile Twin
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap two matching FREE tiles (nothing on top, left or right edge open) Matches refill the clock; fast matches combo. Clear the layout for a bigger one

games.title: Tunnel Hop
games.playableInstructionPreview: Left / right (or hold sides) to move - walls become floors Space / tap jump over missing tiles

games.title: Dune Glide
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / Space to jump, HOLD in the air to backflip Land flat - flips and air time score big

games.title: Egg Roll
games.playableInstructionPreview: Gas right side / Right, brake left / Left Keep the egg in the basket over the hills

games.title: Monster Crush
games.playableInstructionPreview: Gas right side / Right, brake left / Left Land on cars to crush them - flips pay big

games.title: No Brakes
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: arrows / drag - there are no brakes Stay on the twisting road, dodge oncoming cars

games.title: Cab Rush
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: arrows / hold sides, Down / bottom = brake Follow the arrow: pick up, drop off, slow down to stop

games.title: Dirt Dash
games.playableInstructionPreview: Hold GAS (right side / Right), Up/Down to switch lane TURBO is faster but heats the engine - land ramps level

games.title: Road Brawl
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: drag / arrows. Tap left/right edge (or A/D... Q/E) to kick Kick rivals off the road - avoid the cars

games.title: Derby Smash
games.playableInstructionPreview: Steer: arrows / hold sides, Down / bottom = brake Ram rivals nose-first - side hits hurt you

games.title: Dunk Flick
games.playableInstructionPreview: Drag back from the ball and release to shoot Keyboard: arrows aim, Space shoots. No auto-aim.

games.title: Duck Shot
games.playableInstructionPreview: Tap / click the flying birds (or aim with arrows + Space) 3 shots per wave - miss 5 birds and it\'s over

games.title: Paper Toss
games.playableInstructionPreview: Flick upward toward the bin (or Space) Watch the wind - 3 misses and you\'re done

games.title: Skee Roll
games.playableInstructionPreview: Swipe up to roll, steer the ball with your swipe angle Hold and release Space around the green zone for more points

games.title: Neon Circuit
games.playableInstructionPreview: DODGE TRAFFIC · COLLECT ENERGY · SURVIVE THE CIRCUIT

games.title: Rift Survival
games.playableInstructionPreview: MOVE TO SURVIVE · COLLECT SHARDS · CLEAR THE RIFT
